Your 6-10 years of total experience pushed the prediction toward leaving. Similarly, having received other job opportunities during your time here strongly increased the likelihood of departure; most employees predicted to stay never receive such offers. Finally, your 1-5 years in this specific role also contributed to the prediction of leaving, as shorter current tenure often signals that someone is still evaluating their fit and may not stay long-term.

The organization should consider discussing your career goals with you directly and exploring whether improved recognition, better work-life balance, or clearer promotion paths could increase your commitment. You may want to reflect on whether this role still aligns with your long-term plans.
